Hollat has become the preferred choice for government entities and major corporations and is currently working on a cloud-based SAAS model to reinforce its leadership in the Saudi market.

product.name: Hollat Cloud Based CRM
product.description: A cloud-based customer relationship management platform that manages customer tickets and support requests across multiple channels with configurable SLAs.

product.name: Ticket Management System
product.description: A system to track, prioritize, and organize customer support tickets with customizable fields, tags, and statuses for efficient case handling.

product.name: Multichannel Support
product.description: Integration of multiple communication channels into a single platform to manage customer interactions from emails, social media, live chats, and contact forms.

product.name: Advanced Ticketing Analytics & Reporting
product.description: Provides visual reports and analytics on ticket handling performance, team productivity, and customer feedback to inform support strategy improvements.

product.name: User Management
product.description: Tools to create, edit, and manage user accounts with permission settings and activity tracking for secure and organized team collaboration.

product.name: Customizable Workflows
product.description: Allows businesses to tailor ticket routing, assignment rules, and escalation processes to fit their specific operational needs.
